Fixtures for the Hugging Face Evals adapter tests. All of these are shapes
served by the real datasets-server API (https://datasets-server.huggingface.co),
recorded as static bodies and served by the test fake; nothing here requires
network access, a token, or spend.

The x-revision response header is the fingerprint. The test fake serves a
constant revision (the datasetserver test constant "abc123def") unless a test
deliberately drifts it.

Envelope shapes:
  /splits  -> {"splits":[{"config","split"},...]}
  /rows    -> {"rows":[{"row_idx","row"}...],"num_rows_total":N,"partial":false}
